body:
The original native Radeon 780M case at `02ee51f` completed with one `MinimumStep` failure at pixel `(24,23)`: attempt 100, 89 accepted steps, original `.02f` floor. No image was published. Host-only context logging changed no shader or scene settings. All physical/source/volume/identity bytes remained unchanged across the rejected attempt; all 100 bound inputs and 101 whole-map entries stayed stable. Actual child SDK-loader/AMD mappings and postseals joined, and recorded owner/test/auditor births were retired. Capture/ownership acceptance is not a numerical pass.

Independent committed-state algebra gives normalized null residual ≈1.04114e-7 and radius ≈1.62273165089, outside the buffered capture radius ≈1.60819674366. A norm-preserving local canonical reference at 32/64/128 substeps and two finite-difference epsilons finds a sampled inward capture crossing near affine 0.014961783562, before the original 0.019999999553 floor interval ends. The 64→128 endpoint-radius difference is ≈2.03e-12. These are observed refinements and numerical event brackets, not certified error bounds or full-ray qualification.

An independent ideal Cartesian RK4 calculation at the saved state gives the original full-versus-two-half-step scale ratio ≈2.10657 against the unchanged integration bound. Its two-half-step unprojected normalized null residual ≈2.05039e-6 is below the original null bound. This exposes a mathematical truncation limit at the requested floor; actual hidden GPU trial data and its exact rejection conjunct remain unavailable. Source `ed764546` now selects independent fixed composite RK4 meshes before a single counted exact-floor attempt: coarse/fine 2/4 for FP32/COMP, 32/64 for FP64. It covers the original total policy interval and preserves the error/null predicates, projection, floor/rejection rules, ABI and physical dispatch caps. This now passes the finite native controls below; broader P1 and horizon coverage remain open.

Preserved evidence: [raw capture](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/2b654bb1c05df655db6d960a908e9ed7e1bf8a91/attestations/scientific-core/02ee51f/native-amd-kerr-failure-context), [state algebra](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/876075bb7cf3b092712dfa7c685449f3963c4bb9/attestations/scientific-core/02ee51f/kerr-committed-state-analysis), [local canonical reference](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/b3c57f4d59e27b40a74c923b2fc246ef6526623b/attestations/scientific-core/02ee51f/kerr-local-hamiltonian-reference), [Cartesian diagnostic](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/a3b375933d805fc0affd7c8cb56405296d89d261/attestations/scientific-core/02ee51f/kerr-cartesian-floor-diagnostic).

The two new captured-state regressions compare the projected shader endpoint against both immutable unprojected canonical128 reference channels, using the original `2e-5f` bound with no added projection allowance. All prior P1 requirements/evidence remain, and the tests join live Mandatory registration. Strict GCC and source-governance checks passed. The first software-Vulkan regression was stopped by its original aggregate 4 GiB diagnostic RSS guard after 257.311 s (peak 4,204,320 KiB); no XML, shader result or numerical verdict was produced. Seven later software controls remain unrun; there is no unchanged software retry. [Reviewed source and bounded stop](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/4a7cb7f3f74b9ead89b42ae2c4eeebd8535ca014/attestations/scientific-core/ed764546/kerr-floor-composite-source-and-software-rss-stop).

Exact-source integration [CI 38724081383](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38724081383) passed on Windows/macOS/Linux. Both native build gates passed 9/9 with zero failures/errors/skips and 1,152 registrations; all prior 1,150 names/labels/timeouts are preserved. [Current CI products and provenance](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/86c368e55380247a7854493cb86a721259a7ce53/attestations/qualification/ed764546/native-build-ci-38724081383) are build-only evidence. These build records remain distinct from the finite native AMD runtime evidence below. Full science/Mandatory, horizon-domain coverage, viewer and release qualification remain open.

All seven selected native Radeon 780M cases at `ed764546` passed: exact-floor controls in FP32/COMP/FP64, both exact captured-state endpoint regressions, the original 64x64 Kerr image, and the original real FP32/FP64 image comparison. Every case completed one XML test with zero failures/errors/skips/disabled tests. The original image reported shadow fraction `0.109375` and luminance range `[0, 0.874792]`; the precision comparison reported mean absolute difference `1.65563e-7`, maximum `1.07288e-5`, and identical black-pixel counts `448/448`. Original scenes, numerical assertions, interval floor, attempt limits and physical 1000 ms dispatch checks were unchanged. The two captured-state tests passed the original `2e-5f` endpoint comparisons against both canonical reference evaluations with no projection allowance.

Actual same-child staged SDK-loader/AMD mappings, sealed source/product/predecessor inputs, held-handle zero exits and birth-scoped teardown/accessibly visible consumer checks passed independent audits. No diagnostic RSS/time guard stopped these native cases. [Preserved seven-case results, raw logs/XML, controls and independent audits](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/7be3bee9ea8eaee33428b856edf01e511b7c5156/attestations/scientific-core/ed764546/native-amd-kerr-composite-controls). Reported image metrics come from stdout and the original assertions; no raw framebuffer was saved. The finite native passes do not settle the software-Vulkan RSS stop or original cold 128x128/300 s requirement, all P1/scientific witnesses, full Mandatory/UI/horizon-domain or release qualification.
